name: agentory-node-workspace
description: Agentory Node — open-source Host + RuntimeAdapter contract + adapters

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentoryhq/shared && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/runtime-contract && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/adapter-cursor && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/adapter-claude-code && npm run build -w @agentoryhq/node
scripts.test: npm run build && NODE_ENV=test node --test apps/node/dist/discover.test.js apps/node/dist/align.test.js apps/node/dist/probe.test.js adapters/claude-code/dist/index.test.js
